udt_struct_v0.doc: K\xe1\xba\xbf ho\xe1\xba\xa1ch E \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x83 l\xe1\xba\xa1i cho R trong c\xc3\xb9ng tx (ch\xe1\xbb\x89 khi `borrow > 0`).
udt_struct_v0.name: Plan

fields.doc: L\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng vay flash (ph\xe1\xba\xa3i b\xe1\xba\xb1ng `amount` c\xe1\xbb\xa7a callback).
fields.name: borrow

fields.doc: V\xe1\xbb\x91n t\xe1\xbb\xb1 c\xe1\xba\xa5p E chuy\xe1\xbb\x83n cho R tr\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc khi vay.
fields.name: own

fields.doc: `borrow + REPAY_SLACK`: ph\xe1\xba\xa7n tr\xe1\xba\xa3 E duy\xe1\xbb\x87t cho Blend k\xc3\xa9o.
fields.name: repay

udt_union_v0.doc: Lo\xe1\xba\xa1i b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc. Bi\xe1\xba\xbfn th\xe1\xbb\x83 m\xe1\xbb\x9bi (Soroswap, pool CL kh\xc3\xa1c) = capability bit m\xe1\xbb\x9bi; enum \xc4\x91\xc3\xb3ng n\xc3\xaan lo\xe1\xba\xa1i l\xe1\xba\xa1\nkh\xc3\xb4ng decode \xc4\x91\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3c, kh\xc3\xb4ng "fall through".
udt_union_v0.name: Step

cases.doc: Cu\xe1\xbb\x91i v\xc3\xb2ng l\xc3\xa3i < `min_profit` (\xe1\xbb\x9f R: l\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng ra \xe2\x88\x92 own \xe2\x88\x92 ph\xe1\xba\xa7n tr\xe1\xba\xa3; \xe1\xbb\x9f E: s\xe1\xbb\x91 d\xc6\xb0 c\xe1\xbb\xa7a E t\xc4\x83ng th\xc3\xaam).
cases.name: NoProfit

cases.doc: Lender \xc4\x91\xc3\xb2i ph\xc3\xad \xe2\x89\xa0 0: vi ph\xe1\xba\xa1m lu\xe1\xba\xadt ch\xe1\xbb\x89 d\xc3\xb9ng v\xe1\xbb\x91n vay mi\xe1\xbb\x85n ph\xc3\xad.
cases.name: NotFree

cases.doc: Route r\xe1\xbb\x97ng, b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc/hop kh\xc3\xb4ng n\xe1\xbb\x91i nhau, v\xc3\xb2ng kh\xc3\xb4ng kh\xc3\xa9p, ho\xe1\xba\xb7c `min_out` \xc3\xa2m.
cases.name: BadRoute

cases.doc: Callback m\xc3\xa0 kh\xc3\xb4ng c\xc3\xb3 plan do peer \xc4\x91\xe1\xba\xb7t trong ch\xc3\xadnh tx n\xc3\xa0y.
cases.name: NoPlan

cases.doc: Kho\xe1\xba\xa3n vay kh\xc3\xb4ng do peer m\xe1\xbb\x9f.
cases.name: BadInitiator

cases.doc: T\xc3\xa0i s\xe1\xba\xa3n ho\xe1\xba\xb7c l\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng vay c\xe1\xbb\xa7a callback kh\xc3\xa1c plan.
cases.name: PlanMismatch

cases.doc: \xc4\x90\xc3\xa3 c\xc3\xb3 plan \xc4\x91ang ch\xe1\xbb\x9d (kh\xc3\xb4ng bao gi\xe1\xbb\x9d x\xe1\xba\xa3y ra trong lu\xe1\xbb\x93ng \xc4\x91\xc3\xbang).
cases.name: Busy

cases.doc: `own` > s\xe1\xbb\x91 d\xc6\xb0 `asset` c\xe1\xbb\xa7a E: v\xe1\xbb\x91n t\xe1\xbb\xb1 c\xe1\xba\xa5p kh\xc3\xb4ng \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\xa7 cho ph\xe1\xba\xa7n lane khai.
cases.name: NoCapital

cases.doc: G\xe1\xbb\x8di sai vai: `run` v\xc3\xa0o receiver, ho\xe1\xba\xb7c `set_plan` / `exec_op` v\xc3\xa0o instance gi\xe1\xbb\xaf v\xe1\xbb\x91n.
cases.name: WrongRole

cases.doc: Lender tr\xe1\xba\xa3 v\xe1\xbb\x81 m\xc3\xa0 kh\xc3\xb4ng g\xe1\xbb\x8di `exec_op` (plan c\xc3\xb2n \xe1\xbb\x9f R): c\xe1\xba\xa3 tx revert.
cases.name: NoCallback

udt_struct_v0.doc: C\xe1\xba\xa5u h\xc3\xacnh b\xe1\xba\xa5t bi\xe1\xba\xbfn tr\xe1\xbb\xab `operator` (xoay kho\xc3\xa1 n\xc3\xb3ng). \xc4\x90\xe1\xbb\x95i lender/router = deploy m\xe1\xbb\x9bi.
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

fields.doc: V\xc3\xad owner: qu\xe1\xba\xa3n tr\xe1\xbb\x8b, nh\xe1\xba\xadn l\xc3\xa3i, v\xc3\xa0 l\xe1\xbb\x91i ra duy nh\xe1\xba\xa5t c\xe1\xbb\xa7a ti\xe1\xbb\x81n (k\xe1\xbb\x83 c\xe1\xba\xa3 v\xe1\xbb\x91n). Kh\xc3\xb4ng bao gi\xe1\xbb\x9d l\xc3\xaan box.
fields.name: admin

fields.doc: `true` = instance gi\xe1\xbb\xaf v\xe1\xbb\x91n, nh\xe1\xba\xadn `run` (E); `false` = receiver, nh\xe1\xba\xadn `set_plan` / `exec_op` (R).
fields.name: entry

fields.doc: Pool Blend v2: cho vay flash v\xc3\xa0 l\xc3\xa0 contract duy nh\xe1\xba\xa5t \xc4\x91\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3c g\xe1\xbb\x8di `exec_op`.
fields.name: lender

fields.doc: Kho\xc3\xa1 n\xc3\xb3ng k\xc3\xbd `run`. Kh\xc3\xb4ng gi\xe1\xbb\xaf ti\xe1\xbb\x81n.
fields.name: operator

udt_struct_v0.doc: M\xe1\xbb\x99t b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc swap qua router Aquarius. L\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng v\xc3\xa0o **t\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9dng minh**: b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc \xc4\x91\xe1\xba\xa7u = `own + borrow`, b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc sau = l\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng\nra c\xe1\xbb\xa7a b\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc tr\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9bc (gi\xc3\xa1 tr\xe1\xbb\x8b router tr\xe1\xba\xa3 v\xe1\xbb\x81) \xe2\x80\x94 kh\xc3\xb4ng \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x8dc s\xe1\xbb\x91 d\xc6\xb0, n\xc3\xaan v\xe1\xbb\x91n c\xe1\xbb\xa7a E kh\xc3\xb4ng bao gi\xe1\xbb\x9d b\xe1\xbb\x8b cu\xe1\xbb\x91n v\xc3\xa0o.
udt_struct_v0.name: AquaStep

function_v0.doc: **C** \xe2\x80\x94 v\xc3\xb2ng thu\xe1\xba\xa7n Soroban kh\xc3\xa9p v\xe1\xbb\x81 `asset`, l\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3ng v\xc3\xa0o `own + borrow`: `own` l\xe1\xba\xa5y t\xe1\xbb\xab v\xe1\xbb\x91n c\xe1\xbb\xa7a E,\n`borrow` vay flash Blend ph\xc3\xad 0 (0 = kh\xc3\xb4ng ch\xe1\xba\xa1m lender). L\xc3\xa3i = s\xe1\xbb\x91 d\xc6\xb0 `asset` c\xe1\xbb\xa7a E t\xc4\x83ng th\xc3\xaam, \xe2\x89\xa5\n`min_profit`, chuy\xe1\xbb\x83n v\xe1\xbb\x81 admin v\xc3\xa0 tr\xe1\xba\xa3 v\xe1\xbb\x81.
function_v0.name: run

function_v0.doc: N\xe1\xbb\x91i instance kia. Admin, **m\xe1\xbb\x99t l\xe1\xba\xa7n**: \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x95i peer = deploy m\xe1\xbb\x9bi.
function_v0.name: link

function_v0.doc: Lane \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x8dc l\xc3\xbac boot \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x83 so v\xe1\xbb\x9bi env (operator, lender, router, entry).
function_v0.name: config

function_v0.doc: Callback 2/2 \xe2\x80\x94 pool Blend g\xe1\xbb\x8di sau khi chuy\xe1\xbb\x83n `amount` cho ta (`moderc3156::exec_op`). X\xc3\xa1c th\xe1\xbb\xb1c t\xe1\xbb\xab\n**frame c\xe1\xbb\xa7a ta** (plan m\xe1\xbb\x99t l\xe1\xba\xa7n do peer \xc4\x91\xe1\xba\xb7t, pool \xc4\x91\xc3\xa3 c\xe1\xba\xa5u h\xc3\xacnh l\xc3\xa0 ng\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9di g\xe1\xbb\x8di tr\xe1\xbb\xb1c ti\xe1\xba\xbfp), kh\xc3\xb4ng t\xe1\xbb\xab tham\ns\xe1\xbb\x91.
function_v0.name: exec_op

function_v0.doc: Callback 1/2 \xe2\x80\x94 ch\xe1\xbb\x89 peer (E) \xc4\x91\xe1\xba\xb7t \xc4\x91\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3c, trong tx c\xe1\xbb\xa7a ch\xc3\xadnh n\xc3\xb3.
function_v0.name: set_plan

function_v0.doc: **L\xe1\xbb\x91i ra duy nh\xe1\xba\xa5t c\xe1\xbb\xa7a ti\xe1\xbb\x81n.** Ch\xe1\xbb\x89 admin, lu\xc3\xb4n v\xe1\xbb\x81 admin, kh\xc3\xb4ng c\xc3\xb3 tham s\xe1\xbb\x91 \xc4\x91\xc3\xadch. R\xc3\xbat v\xe1\xbb\x91n t\xe1\xbb\xb1 c\xe1\xba\xa5p c\xe1\xbb\xa7a\nE v\xc3\xa0 c\xe1\xbb\xa9u token b\xe1\xbb\x8b g\xe1\xbb\xadi nh\xe1\xba\xa7m \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x81u \xc4\x91i \xc4\x91\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9dng n\xc3\xa0y.
function_v0.name: withdraw

function_v0.doc: E g\xe1\xbb\x8di ngay sau `flash_loan`: plan ph\xe1\xba\xa3i \xc4\x91\xc3\xa3 \xc4\x91\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\xa3c `exec_op` l\xe1\xba\xa5y \xc4\x91i. Ch\xe1\xbb\x89 peer.
function_v0.name: plan_used
